messages:
alex: Heads-up, noticed a weird p95 bump on /v1/generate from ~03:14–03:23 UTC. p50 looks stable, p99 barely moves. Anyone else see this? :thinking:
maria: saw it too. coincides with quota-burst from a tenant -> fallback routing kicked in to cheaper region. p95 up ~120ms. p99 unchanged. :eyes:
sam_k: can you paste the query for that timeframe? i'll grep the logs.
alex: yeah — Grafana link: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234 (open -> dashboard "endpoint-latency")
alex: time range 2024-07-12 03:10:00 -> 03:25:00 UTC
sam_k: quick grep shows lots of retried requests with status 202 and longer backend_time. snippet:
```
2024-07-12T03:14:12Z tenant=alpha endpoint=/v1/generate backend_time_ms=340 route=eu-fallback retry=1
2024-07-12T03:14:13Z tenant=alpha endpoint=/v1/generate backend_time_ms=360 route=eu-fallback retry=1
```
jen_dev: hmm could be smoothing window in dashboard averaging out p99 but showing p95 jump. our rollup config has tdigest merge + decaying-window 60s. when many midtail values appear p95 is sensitive.
maria: i think also sampling origin changed — requests routed to fallback preserve client tags but lost kv-cache hits -> higher median-ish latency for many requests but not the extreme tails. that's why p99 stable.
sam_k: reproducer idea: flood small payloads to primary -> force fallback -> check kvcache miss rate. can run in staging.
jen_dev: note: our percentile calc treats retries as separate samples. that will inflate p50/p95 if retries are common. for p99 it's rare to be dominated by retry noise though.
ops-bot: [alert] RouteFallbackPolicyAlert: eu-fallback weight increased to 0.48 for tenant alpha at 2024-07-12T03:13:57Z; quota exhaustion triggered.
alex: ok, action items: 1) sam reproduce in staging, 2) eng-platform to confirm if dashboard tdigest merge + decaying window could create this pattern, 3) decide whether to mark retries excluded from pctl.
maria: tagging eng-runtime @jen_dev — can you check if kv-cache metrics were zeroed during fallback?
sam_k: starting staging run now, will post results in ~10m.
jen_dev: quick thought: excluding retry-paths from percentile calcs is safe for UX but changes SLO semantics. need docs and opt-in per SLO.
alex: agreed. for this incident let's add a transient annotation on the dashboard explaining fallback-induced p95 drift.
maria: +1. also add sample-origin badge to the latency pane so folks see route source (primary vs fallback) at a glance.
sam_k: staging run done: kv-cache miss rate jumped from 12% -> 94% during fallback, p95 in staging mirrored production pattern. logs & traces: https://traces.internal/trace/0xdeadbeef
alex: great repro. i'll file a quick RFC for the opt-in retry-exclusion and dashboard annotation. thanks all :thumbsup:
